name: Shimabara (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shimabara city emblem in white: an outlined ring divided by diagonal strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shimabara, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1940.

features.role: Shimabara city emblem — an outlined ring divided by diagonal strokes, like a stylised character
